summary: Reference manual domain required by Title 350 Chapter 10 as a source used by county assessors in performing duties; actual manual content remains a future ingestion target.
plain_language: The manual is one of the practical sources an assessor needs beside statutes and regulations.

relationships.note: Manual content should ground field-review practice after ingestion.
Manual-derived office practices may later be crosswalked to internal workflows.

source_refs.citation: Nebraska DOR PAD, Title 350 Nebraska Administrative Code, ch. 10, REG-10-004.
